# Archive Timestamp Chain

The renewal history of an RFC 4998 Evidence Record Syntax (ERS) evidence record for a signed or attested document, so that it can still be verified after the hash or signature algorithms it was created with are no longer secure. Records the shape of the chain: the hash of the protected document, then every archive timestamp in time order — the initial one, each Timestamp Renewal (same hash algorithm, new timestamp) and each Hash-Tree Renewal (new hash algorithm, starts a new chain). Cryptographic verification of the evidence record itself is done outside the schema; this object carries what that verification and a renewal schedule need. Algorithm ids are the ids in reference-data/algorithm-lifecycle-registry.json

Source: [`v3/common/archive-timestamp-chain.json`](../../../v3/common/archive-timestamp-chain.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/common/archive-timestamp-chain.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `evidenceRecordFormat` | const `rfc4998` | yes | The evidence record syntax the chain follows. Only RFC 4998 Evidence Record Syntax is defined |
| `protectedObjectDigest` | [digest](#def-digest) | yes | Hash of the protected data object (the signed will, codicil or other attested document) as covered by the initial archive timestamp. Its algorithm is the initial archive timestamp's digest algorithm |
| `archiveTimestamps` | array of [archiveTimestamp](#def-archiveTimestamp) | yes | Every archive timestamp, ascending by time (RFC 4998 section 5.1). The first is the initial archive timestamp (sequence 0, renewalType initial); each later one is a renewal. Only the newest one's algorithms need to remain secure for the record to verify. Order and the initial-first rule are checked by scripts/check-archive-timestamp-chain.mjs, since JSON Schema cannot compare one item with the next |
| `evidenceRecordContentUrl` | `string` (uri-reference) | | Where the DER-encoded RFC 4998 EvidenceRecord is held |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about the chain, such as the archive service that maintains it |

## Definitions

<a id="def-archiveTimestamp"></a>

### archiveTimestamp

One RFC 4998 ArchiveTimeStamp: an RFC 3161 time-stamp token over a hash tree that covers the protected object or the previous archive timestamps

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sequence` | `integer` | yes | Position in the chain, starting at 0 for the initial archive timestamp and increasing by one |
| `renewalType` | one of `initial`, `timestamp_renewal`, `hash_tree_renewal` | yes | initial: the first archive timestamp over the protected object. timestamp_renewal: covers the previous timestamp with the same hash algorithm, added to the current chain (RFC 4998 section 5.2). hash_tree_renewal: re-hashes the object and all previous chains, normally with a stronger hash algorithm, and starts a new chain |
| `timestamp` | `string` (date-time) | yes | The time-stamp token's generation time (RFC 3161 genTime) |
| `digestAlgorithm` | [digestAlgorithmId](#def-digestAlgorithmId) | yes | Hash algorithm of this archive timestamp's hash tree. Within one chain every archive timestamp uses the same one |
| `signatureAlgorithm` | [signatureAlgorithmId](#def-signatureAlgorithmId) | yes | Signature algorithm of the time-stamping authority's signature on the token |
| `coveredDigest` | [digest](#def-digest) | yes | The hash this archive timestamp covers: the protected object hash for the initial one, the previous timestamp's hash for a timestamp renewal, or the combined object-and-chains hash for a hash-tree renewal. Its algorithm is this archive timestamp's digestAlgorithm |
| `timestampTokenRef` | `string` | yes | Reference to the RFC 3161 time-stamp token, such as a URI or URN in the archive |
| `timestampAuthorityName` | `string` | | Name of the time-stamping authority that issued the token |

<a id="def-digest"></a>

### digest

A hash value with the algorithm that produced it, as lowercase hexadecimal

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `algorithm` | [digestAlgorithmId](#def-digestAlgorithmId) | yes | Hash algorithm that produced the value |
| `value` | `string` | yes | The hash value, lowercase hexadecimal, of the length the algorithm produces |

<a id="def-digestAlgorithmId"></a>

### digestAlgorithmId

A hash algorithm id from reference-data/algorithm-lifecycle-registry.json (kind: digest)

Type: one of `sha-1`, `sha-256`, `sha-384`, `sha-512`, `sha3-256`, `sha3-384`, `sha3-512`

<a id="def-signatureAlgorithmId"></a>

### signatureAlgorithmId

A signature algorithm id from reference-data/algorithm-lifecycle-registry.json (kind: signature)

Type: one of `rsa-pkcs1v15-2048`, `rsa-pkcs1v15-3072`, `rsa-pkcs1v15-4096`, `ecdsa-p256`, `ecdsa-p384`, `ed25519`, `ml-dsa-44`, `ml-dsa-65`, `ml-dsa-87`, `slh-dsa-sha2-128s`, `slh-dsa-sha2-256s`
